claims: McDonald's Demon Sauce is a limited-time dipping sauce.
McDonald's Demon Sauce is vibrant purple.
McDonald's Demon Sauce was released in March 2026.
McDonald's Demon Sauce was released as part of the Netflix KPop Demon Hunters meal partnership.
McDonald's Demon Sauce features a bold, tangy flavor.
McDonald's Demon Sauce features a notable spicy kick.
McDonald's Demon Sauce is designed to accompany the 10-piece McNuggets.
McDonald's Demon Sauce is designed to accompany the Ramyeon McShaker Fries.
McDonald's Demon Sauce is described as a creamy Cajun-style mustard sauce.
McDonald's Demon Sauce offers both heat and tang.
McDonald's Demon Sauce is intentionally colored bright purple.
McDonald's Demon Sauce is colored to match "demon patterns" from the film.
McDonald's Demon Sauce is featured in the Huntr/x Meal.
"Hunter Sauce" is a sweet chili option.
According to McDonald's nutritional information, one serving of McDonald's Demon Sauce contains 130 calories.
McDonald's Demon Sauce is available for a limited time at participating locations.
McDonald's Demon Sauce is meant to be a spicy counterpart to the sweeter "Hunter Sauce".
"Hunter Sauce" is included in the Huntr/x Meal.
